question: What goes away through non-eating by day?
premises: divasāt nāśanena eva means by day through non-eating indeed
vayo mṛtyuṃ gamiṣyate means age and death will go
inference: The verse claims that age and death will go through non-eating by day.
uncertainties: whether divasāt modifies nāśanena or gamiṣyate
plain_english: Through non-eating by day, age and death will go away.
